description: Erection of a single storey rear extension following demolition of existing conservatory, erection of a rear roof extension with front roof windows and erection of a part first floor side extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and access statement, A00LB, A001-PA, A002-PA, A003-PA, A004-PA, Received: 11/05/2020, B001-PA, B002-PA, B003-PA, B004-PA, Received: 16/06/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
